messages.author: 644e1c01c3c42210
messages.subject: Re: error messages
parts:
Hello,

Sorry for the long delay in getting back to you about this error. You're right, we accidentally introduced a small bug in runModels in the development code that broke the function in many cases. I have now patched this bug, which is fixed in the development code, and I just uploaded a new version of the package to CRAN (0.6-2), which also includes the fix.

Cheers,
Michael
